baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct تَنزِيلَ with the paired source names ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Caused delivery joins prevailing capacity to tender beneficence: the source can make the communication arrive despite resistance, while mercy governs what that arrival is for.

activation_trace.role: Caused bringing-down and delivery make تَنزِيل an effective transfer toward recipients.
Prevailing force supplies the delivery's resistance-overcoming efficacy.
Tenderness and benefaction assign that effective arrival a merciful aim.

changed_reading.before: A revelation from the Mighty, the Merciful.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately delivered communication whose arrival is secured by prevailing power and whose purpose is governed by mercy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form تَنزِيلَ can activate arranging a thing in its fitting منزل or rank.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent is not only motion from above; it can be placement into an appropriate station. Power stabilizes the placement, while mercy makes suitability to the recipient part of the arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station turns تَنزِيل into ordered emplacement.
Solidity and cohesion make the assigned placement firm rather than accidental.
Merciful care makes fitness for the receiver a functional feature of the placement.

changed_reading.before: The communication simply falls or comes down.
changed_reading.after: The communication is deliberately set into a fitting order, station, and level of access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vertical relation in تَنزِيلَ is paired with an عزيز source and a رحيم source.
baseline_models.mechanism: A source marked by rarity and difficulty of attainment crosses the very distance that makes it inaccessible. Mercy is expressed as self-lowering delivery without loss of the source's transcendence or strength.

activation_trace.role: Movement and arrival from high to low supply the crossed vertical distance.
Rarity and difficulty of attainment characterize the source as otherwise hard to reach.
Merciful benefaction supplies the reason the inaccessible source makes itself reachable.

changed_reading.before: العزيز is only an honorific attached to the sender.
changed_reading.after: The hard-to-attain source compassionately traverses the hierarchy by making its communication descend.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines the severe-arrival potential of ن ز ل and ع ز ز with the tenderness of ر ح م.
baseline_models.mechanism: An arrival can be weighty, difficult, or crisis-like while remaining merciful in aim. The pairing prevents force and mercy from being separated into unrelated source traits.

activation_trace.role: A severity that descends supplies the disruptive character of the intervention.
Severity of impact gives the arriving communication existential weight.
Tender benefaction constrains the severe impact as protective or corrective rather than gratuitous.

changed_reading.before: Merciful descent must feel only gentle or consoling.
changed_reading.after: The descent may strike as a severe intervention whose weight is itself ordered toward mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence identifies a gathered recitation, its well-made restraint, a sent carrier, and a straight route. It converts bare vertical descent into an engineered delivery path: composed content moves through an emissary along a directed course.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery is the focus mechanism that the preceding sequence specifies.
Gathering and collection make the delivered content cohere rather than arrive as fragments.
Exact construction and secure workmanship give the gathered content controlled form.
Messenger and message supply the human relay through which delivery operates.
The straight road turns delivery into directed passage rather than undirected falling.
Straightness, balance, and evenness stabilize the route and its transmission.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from recited object to messenger to path immediately before the focus source formula.
A vertical delivery term is preceded by a horizontal route construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies composed recitation, emissary, and straight route; I infer that these specify a delivery architecture for تَنزِيل. A live alternative is that they identify product, agent, and setting without describing the internal mechanics of descent.

changed_reading.before: تَنزِيل is an unspecified downward transfer.
changed_reading.after: تَنزِيل is a coherent recitation routed through a messenger on a controlled, straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sending is embodied in vulnerable human messengers, but rejection produces reinforcement rather than transmission failure. The next denial repeats both descent and mercy, making the focus pair operational: merciful delivery can be contested, while العزيز strengthens its carriers.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening one by another is the latent operational sense of العزيز.
Sending and sent messengers provide the repeated human transmission channel.
Explicit reinforcement by another carrier turns العزيز from a static title into transmission support.
The completing third gives the reinforcement a concrete redundancy mechanism.
The opponents' denial directly names the caused descent whose reality the focus asserts.
The Merciful is explicitly made the disputed source of the descent.
Visible human embodiment marks the ordinary-looking medium through which extraordinary delivery arrives.

structural_cues: Two messengers are denied, then strengthened by a third.
The following objection couples أَنزَلَ directly with ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ and rejects human carriers as merely بشر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejection, a third-carrier reinforcement, and denial of merciful descent; I infer that العزيز includes preserving delivery through redundant human relays. The alternative is that reinforcement belongs only to the story and العزيز in 36:5 remains a general divine attribute.

changed_reading.before: Power guarantees delivery abstractly from above.
changed_reading.after: Power actively reinforces fragile human relays when merciful descent is denied, so resistance triggers added transmission rather than defeat.

context_deltas.mechanism: A negated descent of a heavenly army is followed by one cry and total stilling. This contrast distinguishes the positive تَنزِيل from coercive force-deployment: merciful communication is what is sent down, while sovereign judgment needs no descending mass.

activation_trace.role: The focus positively presents caused delivery from the powerful, merciful source.
Prevailing power anchors the contrast between communicative descent and effortless judgment.
Repeated but negated bringing-down marks the military mode that was unnecessary.
A mutually supporting troop supplies the mass-force means explicitly withheld.
Height supplies the vertical origin from which the army does not descend.
A terrifying cry replaces a deployed army as the sufficient operative event.
Singularity compresses the exercise of power into one undivided act.
Life stilled after motion supplies the cry's immediate and complete effect.

structural_cues: The denial of any army descending from heaven is immediately followed by a single effective cry.
Positive تَنزِيل in the focus and negated military إنزال later share the same root but opposite communicative roles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a withheld army-descent and one sufficient cry; I infer a contrast in which revelation is the merciful descent and العزيز needs no mass deployment for judgment. The alternative is a local historical denial of one means, without a general contrast between communication and coercion.

changed_reading.before: العزيز suggests power expressed by overwhelming descending force.
changed_reading.after: The Mighty sends communication down in mercy but can enact judgment without sending any force down at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same العزيز appears over cosmic تقدير, and the next ayah names measured lunar منازل and cyclical return. This realizes the focus's placement branch: تَنزِيل can be staged apportionment into fitting stations and times, not merely a single vertical fall.

activation_trace.role: Placement into a fitting station is the focus potential sharpened by the cosmic sequence.
Merciful care lets measured staging be read as accommodation rather than restriction alone.
Fixed settlement supplies a stable destination within the measured course.
Deliberative apportionment makes the course planned rather than accidental.
The repeated Mighty identifies secure capacity as the author of the measured order.
Assigning a measure that reaches its bound specifies the station sequence.
The explicit stations make the منزل-family spatial image visible inside the surah.
Return after departure adds recurrence and sequence to measured emplacement.

structural_cues: تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ is followed by lunar مَنَازِلَ.
The moon moves through assigned stations until it returns, forming a staged cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies العزيز, measure, stable course, stations, and return; I infer that this cosmic pattern models تَنزِيل as calibrated staging suited to receivers. A live alternative is that the stations remain only astronomical and do not characterize revelatory delivery.

changed_reading.before: تَنزِيل is one completed downward event.
changed_reading.after: تَنزِيل is measured, recurrent emplacement into fitting stations, with powerful order functioning as merciful accommodation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy interrupts a drowning trajectory, preserves benefit until an appointed time, and is then linked to protective response. الرحيم therefore becomes concrete rescue plus granted interval; the descent warns within the very time that mercy keeps open.

activation_trace.role: Delivered communication enters the survival interval as warning and opportunity.
Merciful benefaction is the source quality concretized by rescue and reprieve.
Drowning supplies the lethal trajectory from which mercy excepts the carried lives.
Extraction from peril names the rescue capacity otherwise absent.
The explicit exception of mercy makes compassion the interruption of destruction.
Extended preservation for enjoyment turns rescue into continued opportunity.
A bounded time makes mercy an interval rather than indefinite immunity.
Protective avoidance supplies the human response invited within the granted interval.
Receiving mercy is linked to responding protectively to what lies around the hearers.

structural_cues: An unrescued drowning conditional is interrupted by إِلَّا رَحْمَةً.
Mercy is extended only إِلَىٰ حِينٍ and followed by an imperative of protective response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peril, rescue-negation, mercy as exception, extended benefit, bounded time, and protective response; I infer that the revelation arrives inside a mercy-created decision interval. The alternative is that the rescue scene illustrates providence generally without defining the mode of تَنزِيل.

changed_reading.before: الرحيم contributes a general atmosphere of compassion.
changed_reading.after: الرحيم names concrete rescue and a bounded reprieve in which the delivered warning can still be answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: What the Merciful promised through truthful messengers becomes an uttered peace from a merciful Lord. The descent is therefore time-spanning performative address: it carries a promise whose truthful arrival culminates in safety and peace.

activation_trace.role: Delivered communication carries the promise from source toward eventual realization.
A spoken promise opens expectation and gives the message future-directed content.
The Merciful is identified as the promisor behind the transmitted future.
Fulfillment of promise and deed converts transmitted speech into verified event.
The messengers are the relay whose truth is vindicated by fulfillment.
Safety and freedom from harm specify the culminating content of the address.
Explicit utterance makes peace an addressed word rather than only a condition.
Nurturing, repair, and completion make the Lord the one who brings the promised address to its end.
The repeated Merciful closes the arc by personally sourcing the speech of peace.

structural_cues: The awakened recognize a promise of the Merciful and the truth of the messengers.
The reward sequence culminates in سلام explicitly characterized as قول from a merciful Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promised speech, truthful fulfillment, messenger relay, and final peace-speech; I infer one temporal arc for the focus descent. The alternative is that سلام describes only the reward scene and should not be treated as the telos of every function of revelation.

changed_reading.before: The descent is primarily warning or information delivered in the present.
changed_reading.after: The descent is a truthful promise-bearing address whose content arrives across time and culminates as peace from the Merciful.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead ground is enlivened and yields seed; later the delivered object is a gathered reminder-recitation aimed at whoever is alive. The material revival supplies an analogy for communicative revival: descent reaches latent receptivity and brings living response outward.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery supplies the incoming element in the revival analogy.
Merciful benefaction makes awakened life and benefit the delivery's positive direction.
Earth revived through the rain-and-growth image supplies the material analogue of awakened reception.
Bringing a thing out of concealment models latent response becoming manifest.
Seed that sprouts and bears gives revived life a compact generative unit.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the cognitive awakening function.
Gathering and collection make the recitation a coherent life-address.
Warning awakens caution, specifying how the address activates a living hearer.
Life as benefit and good marks the receptive target toward which warning is directed.

structural_cues: The dead-earth sign moves from revival to emergence of seed and nourishment.
Near the close, the text is defined as reminder and recitation whose warning addresses whoever is alive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material revival, seed emergence, reminder-recitation, and a living addressee; I infer a cross-domain arrow from enlivened earth to enlivened reception of تَنزِيل. The alternative is that حَيًّا only limits the warning's audience and does not describe revelation as life-giving.

changed_reading.before: The descent transfers already formed information to passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: The descent behaves like a germinative mercy: it reaches latent receptivity, awakens caution, and draws living response into the open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final command sequence joins will, saying, and immediate becoming under total sovereignty. It sharpens تَنزِيل as an efficacious placing-act: sourced speech does not merely report a state but installs what is willed into actuality.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing into its fitting station supplies the focus-side model of actualizing emplacement.
Prevailing power guarantees that the sourced act is efficacious rather than merely advisory.
Merciful benefaction constrains the purpose for which efficacious speech is delivered.
Binding command supplies the directive force that moves a state toward actuality.
Will and intention supply the selected state toward which the command is directed.
A determinate thing gives the performative act an object capable of being brought about.
Articulated saying is the explicit medium of the efficacious command.
Occurrence and presence in time give the command its immediate realized result.
The hand as authority locates the act within operative sovereignty.
Kingship and dominion extend that operative authority over every thing.
Return to the source closes the directional circuit opened by descent from the source.

structural_cues: Will, saying, imperative كُن, and realized يَكُونُ occur in one compressed conditional sequence.
The closing dominion and return reverse the focus's outward descent into a final movement back to the source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, will, saying, becoming, dominion, and return; I infer that these expose the efficacy latent in تَنزِيل as sourced speech that places realities. The alternative is that كُن فَيَكُونُ concerns creation generally and does not specify the mechanics of revelation.

changed_reading.before: The descent communicates descriptions and instructions.
changed_reading.after: The descent is an efficacious sovereign saying that installs ordered states while carrying the merciful purpose of its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays gestational enclosure on a laden ship. It remains anchored in the focus's womb branch of ر ح م and emplacement branch of ن ز ل, while pregnancy, dispersed progeny, vessel, fullness, drowning, and mercy converge in the packet. Render only as an exploratory spatial analogy, not as a lexical claim that الرحيم means womb here or that the ship is literally a womb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ر ح م can name the womb as a protected house of growth, while ن ز ل can place something in a fitting station.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a house and vessel of growth supplies the protective enclosure.
Fitting emplacement supplies safe positioning within the moving enclosure and toward delivery.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit activate carried life inside rather than cargo only.
Smallness and dispersal give descendants a seed-like continuity carried through danger.
The ship moving in water supplies the mobile outer enclosure.
Fullness makes the vessel a packed life-bearing interior.
Drowning supplies the death-water against which the enclosure preserves life.
Mercy explicitly interrupts drowning and validates the protective function of the image.

changed_reading.before: Mercy externally rescues passengers from water.
changed_reading.after: Mercy can be imagined as a mobile gestational enclosure that carries dispersed descendants through death-water toward safe emplacement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant and surprising because it activates the seminal sense inside the focus inventory for تَنزِيل. It remains anchored through that exact ن ز ل branch, the womb branch of ر ح م, and the packet's seminal drop and creation sequence. Downstream prose must qualify it as a generative analogy, never as the verse's lexical gloss or as a biological account of revelation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories include emitted seminal water under ن ز ل and the female womb under ر ح م.

activation_trace.role: Emission of seminal water supplies a deposited beginning rather than a finished delivered object.
The womb supplies the receptive site in which a small deposit can develop.
Water ranging from a drop to semen gives the generative deposit an explicit material trigger.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies development from the minute deposited origin.
Initiating and producing a thing carries the small origin into renewed formation.

changed_reading.before: تَنزِيل transfers a finished text from source to recipient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, تَنزِيل can image a seed-like deposit whose merciful reception develops into living address and renewed formation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading shifts from تَنزِيل to the same root's prepared نُزُل hospitality branch, so it is unusual but visibly anchored. The packet's delight, shade, couches, fruit, peace, and merciful host sustain the activation. Render it as a secondary hospitality resonance, not as a claim that تَنزِيل grammatically denotes a banquet.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ن ز ل inventory includes provisions prepared for a guest, paired in the focus with the beneficence of الرحيم.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provisions for an arriving guest turn descent into anticipatory welcome.
Merciful benefaction supplies the host-like care behind the welcome.
Delight and pleasant well-being establish the guests' received enjoyment.
Sheltering shade supplies prepared protection within the welcome.
A couch in a curtained chamber supplies furnished reception.
Reclining and support make the reception restful and settled.
Pleasant fruit supplies the prepared provision proper.
Safety and greeting complete the welcome as peace.
The merciful Lord explicitly sources the final greeting, closing the hospitality resonance.

changed_reading.before: The descent is only an object delivered to hearers.
changed_reading.after: The descent also resonates as provisions prepared ahead for arriving guests, with the Merciful's final peace revealing the destination as welcome.

strongest_changes: العزيز became operational reinforcement of vulnerable human relays and also power that needs no descending army.
تَنزِيل shifted from a single downward event to measured emplacement through assigned stations and recurrent timing.
الرحيم became concrete rescue, bounded reprieve, fulfilled promise, and finally speech of peace.
The closing command sequence made descent readable as efficacious speech that places a willed state into actuality.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reactivated the focus roots in diagnostic forms: عَزَّزْنَا turned a title into reinforcement, أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ exposed the disputed source-act, مَنَازِلَ joined descent to cosmic measure, and رَّحِيمٍ sourced the final سلام. Material life, transport, and generation then opened contained but unusually coherent womb, seed, and hospitality readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the measured-stations model describes revelation's actual staging or is only a productive cosmic analogy.
Whether mercy governs the mode of delivery, its intended outcome, the interval it grants, or all three without collapse.
The womb, seminal, and hospitality activations are traceable but remain branch-shifts whose exegetical weight is uncertain.
